full_chain_observation.source: ModMenuIntegration whole; NeoForge entry45-78; ClientTickMixin whole
full_chain_observation.observation: ModMenu factory and shown NeoForge extension return new HomeScreen(parent); keybinding path creates new HomeScreen(current screen) while player exists. Loader wrappers/hotkey are the same host flow, not separate references.

Home owns final parent, per-instance UpdateState, found-version string and updateChecked. Constructor gives translated title. Static HTTP client is shared, but guard/result ownership are per Home instance.

init clears widgets, computes controls and buttonsLeftX from current width/height, creates Settings/Profile callbacks with this as their parent, then sets updateChecked before starting check only when false. Normal later init on same object does not request another check.

Check also refuses while CHECKING, sets CHECKING before daemon thread. Request built from loader/current-MC metadata, has request timeout10sec and User-Agent current mod version; shared client construction asks connect timeout5sec. Source values are not measured timing or guarantee of termination.

Only HTTP200 response enters JSON array processing. Iterate entries, apply hasLoader predicate and choose greatest version under local comparator among nonnull version_number entries. Exceptions caught as Exception are ignored and converge to no found result.

hasLoader accepts missing or JSON-null loaders defensively; provided array needs matching primitive entry. URL filter plus this predicate are source behavior, not proof returned project releases match current runtime.

Comparator strips a dash suffix, otherwise plus suffix, then compares dot segments as Integer when both parse, otherwise lexical strings; missing segments count0. This is local custom ordering, not a fully verified semantic-version algorithm.

Worker captures found string and requests Minecraft.execute callback. Callback sets ERROR for null/empty, OUTDATED plus stored version for greater result, otherwise LATEST. It captures Home instance fields, with no current-screen identity or generation check.

Callback can mutate retained Home while child/another page is current. No removed() override, future cancellation, retry button or updateChecked reset occurs in complete Home class; ordinary failure remains guarded for same instance.

Host status drawing reads updateState and current width/height in its own render extraction; idle suppresses status. Checking/latest/outdated/error captions are resolved from translation components per draw, with current/stored version values supplied as needed.

Only no-world branch requests panorama. Title/status/controls align to host-derived coordinates, with status bottom current height-30. This source own backdrop strategy is reference only; Dynasty background is preserved.

Child Profile retains same Home parent. Done conditionally saves current settings then loads selected profile (or saves same profile) before setScreen(parent); onClose returns parent without committing selection. Profile list refreshes on its init, not by calling Home init directly.

Settings constructor reloads config and snapshots. Shown Save & Close saves and returns parent; cancel dirty opens confirmation, clean path reloads then returns. Escape dirty prompts; confirmation cancel/Escape returns same settings, confirm loads config then returns Home parent. These calls do not prove disk success.

Auxiliary dialog retains settings screen and uses current dimensions/translations. Cancel/Escape returns settings; confirm calls external AnimaApi.enterConfigWorld(settings). External launcher and actual gate producer are not read in this batch, so this is auxiliary0, not a completed launch chain.

Shown button click paths check active/visible/left mouse/hit bounds before invoking captured Runnable. Home/Profile styled controls are separate local implementations; no keyboard activation override is shown. Narration delegates default text, not proof full keyboard accessibility.

Basic settings translation/search/rebuild/cancel already owned by UIREF005 and shared support0. Candidate novelty is Home-owned one-shot async update state surviving subpage residence, callback delivery into retained host and localized status using current host viewport. All sibling screens/loader paths remain one whole maximum.

full_chain_observation.observation: PNC dispatcher requires current screen type before live model visibility refresh. Home callback does not require active Home, so hidden retained host can receive its result; when/if drawn later it resolves own status. complete_candidate_unchanged.concrete_observation: One Home host retains its asynchronous update request/result across nested settings/profile navigation. Instance guard suppresses normal init repeats; result callback mutates retained host regardless current screen; status is localized and positioned using host current viewport when rendered. Failure/no-cancel/no-retry limits are part of the whole.
application_to_current_UI: Separate a notification data owner from current visible entry. A retained host can keep a result while a child is current, but subscriptions, polling, cancellation and redraw need explicit ownership; Realms current-TitleScreen predicate cannot be bypassed by this analogy.
Compute layout and notification anchors from current owning page dimensions without rerunning parent service initialization just to repair stale background geometry.
Keep state captions translatable, resolve display text for current locale, and distinguish ERROR/CHECKING/success; preserve original Forge update switch and avoid introducing unsolicited tutorials.
limitations: HOLD0: independent applicability and semantic review pending; UI accepted baseline remains5, not6 or7. At most one candidate whole, Main can merge0 into prior005 if host/subpage scope already owned.
Complete Home303 read is core. Profile205, Confirm71, auxiliary world prompt72, Meta33, styled52, tick76 and ModMenu adapter are shared support, not extra references.

DamageConfigScreen read80-185 and815-848 only; NeoForge entry45-78 only. Incidental preceding fields/partial sibling methods, late render tail and class header are preserved raw but not claimed full ancestor/business reads.
HTTP client, parser, Minecraft.execute scheduling and external services were not executed; client timeout constants do not establish real elapsed deadlines, delivery order or successful callback.

No current-screen/generation guard or cancellation in Home; writing a retained hidden instance is observed source policy, not a confirmed runtime defect or proof arbitrary requests cannot outlive navigation.

Same-instance updateChecked is set before launch and never cleared in complete Home, including ERROR. New Home instances have new guards; this is not process-wide dedup and no automatic retry assurance.
Local version comparator accepts/normalizes different strings without full SemVer semantics. Actual available versions, loader environment, endpoint behavior and dates are not checked online.

Parent reference retention and source setScreen calls establish destination, not native resized-return rendering, user focus preservation or exactly-once service work; current newer-version Screen internals are not read here.

Config save/load filesystem behavior and exceptions, current profile persistence and snapshot equality internals are not read; outer UI call ordering only. No filesystem action from these source methods was performed.
World-needed confirmation is auxiliary only; Anima launcher and actual gate producer outside batch not read. The documented dedicated-world guarantee is not independently confirmed.
Newer GuiGraphicsExtractor/MouseButtonEvent and loader source cannot be copied as Forge1.20.1 code. No compiling or game launch occurred.
Button narration exists, but native keyboard activation/tooltip extraction behavior is not fully traced; comment about automatic tooltips/render pipeline is not verified engine behavior.
No style, texture or background redesign, production patch, sharedJar mutation, game-instance/save access, ledger/task cleanup or native acceptance.

complete_old_comparison_unchanged.PNC_complete_scope: Editor original-widget identity -> nested settings -> replacement model -> parent mapping rebuild; live view model+enabling predicate -> bidirectional payload handler helper mutation request -> current-screen-qualified generic visibility/message refresh. One complete UI ownership flow at most.

PNC_full_business_observations.finding: Client setup registers factories once through the shown setup callback. The BUTTON factory constructs both the live widget and its corresponding configuration screen; concrete dispatch is by registered widget type.
Right click requires hovered widget in programming area, obtains model from widgetMap, requests configuration screen, captures configuringMCWidget and switches to that screen only if nonnull.

Config screen owns translatable title; init computes guiLeft/guiTop from its own width/height. Text/tooltip fields and enable condition are populated from retained model; parent editor is return/update destination.
Button settings add their own width/height and click-assignment fields. Labels use translated captions and measured width to align the two size fields, while numeric X/Y/Z markers remain literal.

Player-global/server-global prefix controls change list contents and displayed prefix. Enable variable namespace and click variable namespace are separate fields of this same editor flow, not separate reference instances.

onClose creates replacement model from current fields, sends it to editor when nonnull, then sets editor current. Text parsing accepts component JSON or wraps plain text; parse error becomes literal error component rather than blocking close.

Edited widget record preserves position via existing WidgetSettings, changes text/size through new records, and carries enable variable and value separately from click variable/value. This is model ownership distinct from a live AbstractWidget identity.

Editor update applies only when configuringMCWidget nonnull, still mapped, and current model unequal to replacement. It replaces model at old widget key, clears configuringMCWidget and requests rebuild. Equal/missing path does not clear it in this method.

Rebuild branch copies retained model values into a new LinkedHashMap of newly constructed controls, adds renderables, then clears old map and replaces it. Import/pastebin/empty branches precede this branch and remain distinct source conditions; no claim all entry paths necessarily enter rebuild branch.

Programming/tray coordinates are evaluated relative to current getGuiLeft/getGuiTop. Drag stores replacement model coordinates relative to editor origin, not absolute screen coordinates. Drag/copy variants belong to same editor and receive zero separate credit.

Editor close selects only widgets whose current widget position lies in programming area, then requests item save and update packet if current hand holds remote item. UI close request is observed; full server persistence/application was not reviewed.

Live remote init obtains saved layout, creates controls with this screen owner and computes each visible flag from enable predicate. Editor requests same builder without filtering. This source uses visible, not active, for enable condition.

Empty enable variable permits visible state; otherwise read player-context position with ZERO default and compare whole BlockPos to enablingValue. Percent variables select server-global store via helper; hash/unprefixed variables select player store.

Packet handler invokes helper setPos/setStack before, on clientbound flow, calling current-screen refresh dispatcher. Dispatcher acts only if current Minecraft.screen is RemoteScreen, not retained editor/config screens.

For changed variable name matching a variable widget, invoke its factory-specific callback. Regardless of that match, every mapped widget message is reparsed and visible recomputed from enable condition. BUTTON factory inherits empty per-variable callback, yet generic visibility refresh still runs.

Live button geometry is local model coordinates plus current screen origin. Click callback sends position packet only when click var name nonempty. Tooltip is retained model component; drawing/click/state ownership is explicit but network success not proven.

RemoteScreen.init as read adds newly built controls to retained widgetMap without explicit clear in these classes. Generic base selected init does not prove all lifecycle cleanup or absence of stale references. Do not treat this source as a proven flawless resize implementation.

PNC_full_business_observations.finding: Translation/parent retention/basic rebuild portions overlap old references and are support0. Home final parent and per-instance updateChecked/state/foundVersion differ from static shared HTTP client. Normal init clears and reconstructs widgets with current dimensions before guarding update launch; same object never resets updateChecked, including ERROR.
Settings/Profile controls capture this Home as child parent. Closing Home returns its parent without a Home removed/cancel method; retained async result ownership persists in source while hidden.

New ModMenu/NeoForge factory calls create a new Home object, so their guard is not process-wide. Hotkey while player exists consumes each queued click and constructs Home(current screen), potentially capturing an earlier Home; no runtime nested-screen defect or multi-request count was tested.

checkForUpdates additionally returns if CHECKING, otherwise sets CHECKING before starting a daemon thread. Request asks10s timeout and static client5s connect timeout; these are source settings, not measured completion or cancellation guarantees.

update URL includes runtime MC name and detected loader; missing/null loader list is explicitly accepted, supplied list needs matching primitive. URL/predicate do not establish external release eligibility or current service behavior.

HTTP200 alone enters array selection. Critically latest is assigned incrementally and catch does NOT reset it: an Exception AFTER an earlier valid candidate may preserve a nonnull result and yield LATEST/OUTDATED. Author F05 statement all caught exceptions converge to no-found is overbroad and requires acknowledgment/correction.

Exception before any candidate, HTTP non200 or no selected candidate generally leaves null; callback treats null OR empty as ERROR. No real HTTP/parser/backend action was executed, and catch(Exception) is not catch of all Throwable.

The posted Minecraft.execute callback mutates captured Home fields without current-screen identity, generation, removed cancellation or future tracking. This is actual retained-host policy, not a proven bug. Scheduler admission/thread affinity and screen engine lifecycle were not read.

Custom comparator treats missing dot segments as0; Integer parse overflow falls back to lexical compare. stripSuffix chooses first dash when any dash exists, otherwise first plus, not necessarily earliest of both. This is not full SemVer, nor externally verified release ordering.

When rendered, host recomputes translated title/developer/status strings from Components and own current width/height. Status anchor uses current height-30, button row horizontal anchor updated by init. No native locale/resize visual pass is inferred.

Home requests panorama only with no world and manually extracts child widgets. Comments about blur and automatic tooltip behavior are author comments; engine render pipeline not independently traced. Existing Dynasty background is protected.

Profile init refreshes profile names and lays out fixed-height unscrolled entries, selectedProfile retained separately. Done saves current then loads selected when changed; same selection saves; null skips persistence then returns parent. Escape merely returns parent. Full config IO/backend and many-profile fit remain unverified.

Settings constructor loads config and snapshots, distinct from init rebuild; selected init saves list scroll, closes color picker, rebuilds translated controls, clamps tab scroll and preserves search text. Constructor/load/snapshot consumer backend and actual unsaved equality logic are not fully read.

Settings Save calls save then clears dirty flag and returns; clean Cancel reloads before parent, while clean onClose returns without reload. Dirty paths prompt. Confirm cancel/Escape returns SAME settings, confirm reloads then returns parent; no actual disk rollback guarantee.

World-needed prompt is a separate auxiliary with retained settings destination and current geometry. Confirm merely calls unread AnimaApi; launcher prerequisite producer and native world opening are not established.

Home/Profile local StyledButton and config StyledButton all gate mouse press with active/visible/left/hit. Narration defaults are shown, no key activation override shown; no general accessibility or flawless focus claim. Merely reading playDownSound does not execute audio.
